caseName: Reno v. American Civil Liberties Union
caseNameFull: Reno, Attorney General of the United States v. American Civil Liberties Union

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. E. D. Pa. Probable jurisdiction noted. Brief of appellants is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, January 21,1997. Briefs of appellees are to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, February 20, 1997. A reply brief, if any, may be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, March 7, 1997. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
